headline: Zimbabwe 2027 Budget Cuts IMTT Slightly by 0.25%, Allocates ZWG59.5B to Security
summary: Finance Minister Mthuli Ncube presented the 2027 National Budget, rejecting industry appeals to repeal the Intermediated Money Transfer Tax by reducing it by 0.25%, while allocating ZWG59.5 billion to security ministries.
why: Zimbabwe's fiscal measures and IMTT transaction tax levels directly impact banking system usage, formal commerce, and electronic payment adoption across the economy.

impacts.name: Zimbabwe
impacts.why: The 2027 budget delivered only a minimal 0.25% cut to the transaction tax while prioritizing security spending.
